# Perch: product information

Canonical website: https://perched.fyi/
Perch is an independent native Mac utility built with SwiftUI and AppKit. It requires macOS 14 or later. It keeps agent activity and pinned sticky notes at the edge of the screen.

## Features
A small screen-edge tab opens a shelf with Needs you, Working, and Recent sessions. Session actions can open the provider or supported session, copy a resume command, or hide a session until it changes. Ten sticky notes in four colors keep short reminders nearby. Keyboard shortcuts and local storage are included. Users review local provider hook changes before installing, and can pause monitoring or remove hooks in Settings.

## Integrations and limitations
Adapters exist for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Claude Code CLI and Cursor local Agent activity have been checked live, and Codex CLI answering was checked live; the Codex desktop app is not verified yet. Cursor passive hooks do not expose awaiting-permission status. Answering is opt-in and off by default: for Claude Code, Perch can allow or deny tools, answer questions, approve or revise plans, and reply when a turn ends; Codex supports allow, deny and replies; Cursor supports a reply when a turn finishes. Every answer has a two-second undo, and Perch never answers on its own. Ordinary Claude chats and OpenCode are not supported. Cursor opens the app rather than a specific chat. Terminal sessions open their terminal host.

## Privacy
The current app keeps events and notes local, discards prompts, tool contents, and credentials, and makes no network requests. No Perch account or server is required. Agent providers remain separate. The website is intended for Cloudflare hosting and has no advertising or analytics scripts. Future purchases use Stripe-hosted checkout.

## Pricing and availability
$29 USD as a one-time app purchase for the first 1,000 customers, then $99, plus applicable taxes shown at checkout. Includes a year of updates and email support, and a full refund within 14 days. Source code is not included. Coding-agent subscriptions and API usage are separate. Purchases are closed until delivery is ready. No payment is collected. No delivery date is promised. Final license, update coverage, device limits, support, and refund details will be published before sales open.
